notes:
Docket now notices an update while you have it open, and one more AI crawler is checked.

Until now Docket looked for a new version only when it started. An app left open for
days never asked again, so a release could sit unnoticed. It now checks every half hour
while it is running — and only tells you. Nothing downloads or installs without you
choosing it, exactly as before.

The AI crawler check has gained Claude-User, the agent that fetches a page when someone
asks Claude about you. Docket already checked whether your server refuses ClaudeBot and
Claude-SearchBot; it now checks all three that Anthropic documents. If your CDN turns one
away while your robots.txt welcomes it, the report says so.

Also fixed: starting a watchlist check and then stopping monitoring in the same moment
left the window showing a check that never finished. It now clears.
